purpose: Determine whether 1-km daily Daymet precipitation and atmospheric-moisture variables can be extracted reproducibly for NAAMP physical stops at matched survey dates before defining or reading any frog-response endpoint.

source.dataset: Daymet daily North America Version 4 / R1
source.access: Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC collection daymet-daily-na

eligibility_checks: STAC collection exists and exposes a cloud-native asset suitable for random/point access.
Variables prcp, vp, tmin, tmax and time/x/y coordinates are present.
NAAMP coordinates can be transformed into the Daymet Lambert Conformal Conic grid.
A deterministic 20-site audit sample can retrieve all four variables for a representative 2005 date without full-domain reads.
deterministic_audit_sample: First 20 SiteIDs by SHA256(SiteID), independent of frog outcomes.
